scope: KCMO boundary only; edge buffer 0 m; saved listing data without interactive filters; explicit user address corrections applied
method: Unique original GIS parcel IDs; internal point assignments. Single-family code 1111; duplex 1122; townhouse 1121 separately. Residential denominator includes codes 1111,1112,1121-1126. Parcel counts are not dwelling counts or land area.
stronger_fit_rule: At least 100 residential plots; single-family plus duplex >=80% of all plots and >=90% of residential plots; unknown <=10% of all plots. Analyst-selected screening criteria, not an official designation.
